in_sanskrit.name: राजत्दीप
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: राज (Raja) + तत् (Tat) + दीप (Deep) = राजत्दीप (Rajatdeep). Raja means king and Deep means light or lamp. So, Rajatdeep means shining as king or radiant.

in_hindi.name: राजत्दीप
in_hindi.meaning: राजा के साथ दीप (Deep with a king)
in_hindi.long_meaning: राजा (Raja) + दीप (Deep) = राजत्दीप (Rajatdeep). राजा के साथ दीप के अर्थ में यह नाम किसी राजा के साथ ज्योतिष्का या सूरज का अर्थ देता है। (This name signifies a lamp or light with a king. It could mean a king with a bright light or a king who is the light himself.)

in_tamil.name: ராஜத்திப்பே
in_tamil.long_meaning: ராஜ் (Raja) + த்திப்பே (Deep) = ராஜத்திப்பே (Rajatdeep). Raja means king and Deep means deep or profound. So, Rajatdeep means deep as a king or profound.

in_telugu.name: రాజటీప్
in_telugu.long_meaning: రాజీ (Raji) + టీప్ (Deep) = రాజటీప్ (Rajatdeep). Raji means king and Deep means deep or profound. So, Rajatdeep means deep as a king or profound.
